title: Cost of one browser tab at fixture volume: counts, bytes, heap, DOM, main-thread time, gzip transfer

workload.per_route: cold load (new context = empty cache), first tab switch where a tablist exists
workload.uxm_spec: apps/portal/frontend/e2e/execution-v2-coexistence.spec.ts (measure mode on 1 and 2 workers, then guard mode)
workload.browser: Playwright chromium (headless), viewport 1440x900, cache cold per test, page clock fixed at the double's NOW
workload.doubles: in-process BFF doubles (apps/portal/frontend/e2e/bffDouble*.ts), FIXTURE_SCALE via bffScale.setFixtureScale
workload.gzip_front: emulates deploy/nginx/portal.conf (gzip level 5, >= 1024 B, json/js/css/text/svg, immutable /assets/)

stop_conditions: any request leaving the app origin fails the test (foreign must be 0)
a failing Playwright test is listed in failed_titles and marks the stage failed
no Docker, no lock, no other container touched

m1b_gzip_front.front: gzip level 5, min 1024 B, nginx types, immutable /assets/, no-store index.html (deploy/nginx/portal.conf)
m1b_gzip_front.warm_cache: NOT_MEASURED: Playwright page.route() (needed for the BFF doubles) disables the HTTP cache, so the second navigation re-downloaded everything (same file count, same wire bytes as cold). A warm-cache figure needs the API served by a real process (fixture BFF behind the front) instead of route stubs; not built here.
m1b_gzip_front.brotli: NOT_MEASURED: deploy/nginx/portal.conf enables gzip only (no brotli module configured); a brotli front is a deployment decision, not a measurement here.

playwright.note: an original failure is a visibility timeout under host load; the failing tests were re-run once, rows appended

resources.note: task/script/layout times and wall times are valid only with the loadavg shown; counts and bytes are load-independent

cleanup.note: Playwright stops its own webServer; contexts are closed by the runner; dist-v2 is gitignored build output

limitations: Doubles answer in-process with 5-50 rows per list (small) up to 1,500 orders / 400 operations (large): NOT 10^3-10^5 rows, so the virtualization break point is not located.
Byte counts depend on the fixtures; they are regression guards, never production budgets (rule R-B).
JS heap is after a forced GC at one instant; main-thread time is CDP TaskDuration (cumulative from page start) - no CPU throttling, no real device.
route_ready_wall_ms is a TTI proxy (navigation to the V2 root being non-loading) on a loaded shared host, not Lighthouse TTI.
Real source, real API latency, real network and brotli are not part of this run (M-1c needs Core009 + a window).
FIXTURE numbers are not calibration evidence and approve nothing.
notes: DEBT-UXM07-044 (closed at 5de8c4b9): the 1-worker count of 12 for workbench is the correct one. The 12th request is GET /governance/stage-action-eligibility (3033 B), started by the Paper exit control when it mounts after the profile answered; in the 2-worker run the read landed after the first-load snapshot (first load 11 requests, 182486 B; 3033 B in the tab window) because networkidle resolves at once when the page was idle earlier. This receipt is not re-cut: its numbers are the run as it happened.
